records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Engaged, friendly reply (email:b0d9f1be) but no concrete action after two nudges (email:5b7b1189, email:8c5cdd73): no project, no invite, no milestone at day 6. Pro plan and zero tickets suggest intent and no blockers, so self-serve activation in 8 days is plausible but not likely.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Glad to hear it's going well so far and that the layout is starting to click -- thanks for the update.

One thing that usually makes the rest fall into place: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first real project in is the useful next step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would you like me to walk you through that first project on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
